status: Planning baseline defined; final character and B-07 physical-device validation not performed

asset_format.runtime_export: glTF2.0 GLB; preserve original output and SHA-256 separately
asset_format.rig_mapping: Inspect actual generated hierarchy/weights before mapping; no claim that auto-rig names match the contract
asset_format.weapon: Separate rigid rifle; right-hand attachment, weapon-local left-hand support point and muzzle position/forward axis

animation_baseline.locomotion: One authored full-body alternating in-place forward gait; rotate the same actor to movement direction in the selected first control scheme
animation_baseline.fire: Coordinated upper-body stabilization/small recoil blended over idle/locomotion without resetting gait
animation_baseline.future_independent_aim: Keep movement and facing states distinct; backwards/strafe-with-fixed-aim clips are future additions, not required for the selected initial control
animation_baseline.timing: Author actual time/contact landmarks and loop seam; do not force17/20/47 frames or copy old2D phase/muzzle coordinates
animation_baseline.authority: Simulation owns movement, firing interval, shot direction and damage. Animation expresses events; it does not set combat speed

game_display.framing: Include hair, cloth, rifle tip and boots at all used poses/rotations with margin; final character framing may differ from the temporary probe. Do not align each pose by alpha bounds

first_device_validation.resolution: Preserve current logicalUI1280x720; record actual Android display mode, window/framebuffer and3D viewport resolutions separately. Do not claim logical UI dimensions are actual GPU render resolution
first_device_validation.comparison: Same map, save/seed, enemy count and input for existing rendering and Plan B preview
first_device_validation.sustained_session: At least10minutes of continuous play or consecutive same-stage runs covering that time; record start/end conditions
first_device_validation.acceptance: Measure against60fps/16.67ms target and check recurring input/visual stalls; below-target results remain a failure/limitation requiring improvement or an explicit evidence-based producer criterion decision. Never mark an unrun device PASS
first_device_validation.extreme1540_entity_stress_scope: Separate known stress issue, not silently included as already solved

initial_gameplay_checks: Nonzero movement input determines facing through the existing screen/world transform
Releasing movement retains the last valid facing; before the first movement use the existing valid initial direction
Basic rifle fires in facing direction during active combat even without enemies
Enemies behind/off the aim line do not turn the basic rifle or hero
Each burst bullet snapshots direction at its actual firing tick
Other skills retain their own targeting without overwriting hero-facing state
Pause, level-choice and terminal-state firing guards remain
Immediate wall/hit consumption still produces the committed-shot visual event
Do not reset gait on shooting/turning or modify damage/firing interval/movement speed
device_reference_scope: S20+ display supports60/120Hz. This is a device specification, not evidence VIYA meets either frame rate
